Players Committee card image of [[Tarkin's Bounty (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on an Imperial leader (may immediately take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle). Leia may not cancel Force drains where you have an Imperial. If on Tarkin, once per turn may peek at top card of any Reserve Deck.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/tarkinsbounty.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
